From IT to Game Development: I turned

what I knew how to do into what I wanted to do.

curse-of-the-crimson-stag.description: Curse of the Crimson Stag is a **story-driven thriller** where you explore the thin line between supernatural events and past tragedies. Discover why the luxurious **Whiteroot Hotel** was abandoned. Local myths speak of a wrathful spirit known as the **Crimson Stag**...

golf-battle.description: Golf Battle is a **real-time multiplayer** minigolf game, from 1v1 up to **6 players**. Over 120 holes, courses and levels, with **dynamic obstacles** (geysers, ditches, moving barriers) and a **progression system** with customizable clubs and balls.

project-remind.description:
_This is the end. My end_.
Operate machinery, uncover secret passages and hack computers to piece your **fragmented life** back together, from your very first memory to your last breath. Investigate the presence of a **mysterious figure** as you search for the answer to your greatest mystery.

call-of-ilaria.description: Set off on an adventure alongside **Maronna HereWhere**, a brave explorer determined to uncover the mystery behind the sudden disappearance of her dearest friend. Along the way you'll fight enemies, recover mysterious items (including a book that allegedly **_smells of death_**) and interact with the eccentric inhabitants of a **very strange village**...

time-to-rest.description: Play as a cheerful **skeleton minion** who, tired of losing yet another battle, decides to take a well-deserved **vacation from the game** he lives in. You'll solve platforming challenges, combine items and environmental puzzles to finally earn the **rest** you've been longing for.

bosque.description:
_Where the wind rises._
Bosque is a playtest map set in a fantasy forest, built with Unreal Engine during the **Shader Development** course at ITS Academy Lazio Digital, taught by the former Lead Technical Artist of **One-O-One Games**. Together with my classmates, we developed shaders for altitude-based **texture transitions**, a **dynamic wind** system for vegetation, seasonal foliage change with falling leaves shifting color, fireflies via **particle systems**, a character trail, **cell shading** for its visual style, and a realistic river water material.

astrofox.description:
_A space journey._
AstroFox is a third-person adventure platformer where you play as a toy fox brought to life after being launched into space, along with **tons of Earth's garbage**. Guided by the enigmatic yet friendly **Nebulinos**, you'll journey across different planets, **recycling waste** along the way to overcome challenges and solve puzzles, in a desperate attempt to **find your way home**. The project was created during the **Unreal Engine Programming** course at ITS Academy Lazio Digital, taught by instructors from **Red Hog Studio**. With the theme _Running out of Space_, built together with my classmates, this was our very **first project** ever on Unreal Engine!

games-bond.description: Games Bond is a **serious game** designed to educate through play, built with Unity and C#. The goal was to raise awareness among young people entering the workforce about **cybersecurity** and the risks of cyberattacks, helping them navigate the digital world more safely and consciously. The game confronts players with the most common security vulnerabilities: avoiding cyber threats, spotting phishing emails, and protecting passwords and sensitive data. The project was developed with the support of **Vigamus Academy**, Exprivia and ITS Academy Lazio Digital, and placed **second** out of nineteen projects in the "Digital Services" category at **ITS Day 4.0** 2023, organized by the Italian Ministry of Education and Ca' Foscari University of Venice.

cubethon.description: Cubethon is an **endless runner** where you control a colored cube, dodging the grey blocks blocking your path. **Minimalist** design and simple gameplay, built to test your reflexes. The project was built in Unity following the Game Design and Development course by **Michigan State University** and **Brackeys**' tutorials on YouTube.

space-debris-3d.description: Space Debris 3D is a 3D platformer where you play as our **trusty astronaut**, exploring a three-dimensional world. Face hostile enemies, cross deadly rivers of lava and collect keys to advance between rooms, discovering what the **friendly NPCs** have to say along the way. The project was built in Unity and C# following the Game Design and Development course by **Michigan State University**. Starting from the base version required by the course assignment, I added a **dialogue system** with NPCs, keys and doors color-coded by type, two new levels with brand-new challenges (including deadly lava), and a key **inventory** visible in the GUI.

space-debris-2.description: Space Debris 2: Defence! puts you in the shoes of an **astronaut** trapped in a **hostile space base**, facing relentless enemies, inverted gravity and toxic pools to avoid while finding a way out, collecting keys and power-ups scattered across the levels. The project was built in Unity and C# following the Game Design and Development course by **Michigan State University**. Starting from the base version required by the course assignment, I added an **inverted gravity** mode that lets you walk on ceilings (with dedicated enemies and checkpoints), the ability to use enemies as indestructible platforms, text feedback when activating checkpoints, two new levels, and a key **inventory** in the GUI.

space-debris.description: Pilot a **spaceship** through waves of space enemies, putting your reflexes to the test. Dodge projectiles with agile moves and defeat enemies to advance through the levels. This project was built during the Game Design and Development course by **Michigan State University**. Simple and rough around the edges, but I'm attached to it because it was my first Unity and C# project, as well as my very **first video game ever**! Starting from the base version required by the assignment, I added a more complete GUI (remaining lives, enemies defeated and remaining, minimap), animated destructible asteroids, an enemy space station that **spawns opponents**, a bigger and tougher final boss, **power-ups** granting extra lives, and new levels with brand-new challenges.

about.title: About me
about.introText: I'm a <hl>Game Programmer</hl> and I work mainly on Unreal Engine and Unity, using C++, Blueprint, and C#. After my Master's degree in <hl>Computer Engineering</hl> I've never stopped learning: solo indie prototypes, team projects, all the way to studio development on <hl>published titles</hl>. What fascinates me about Game Dev is a challenge that never stops exciting me: starting from something that doesn't exist and turning it into something <hl>real</hl>.

one-o-one-games.description: Developing gameplay systems, UI and tech animation from scratch. Reverse-engineering existing systems to support new feature development.

miniclip.description: Implementing gameplay mechanics and UI with player experience as the guiding metric. Developing live features and automated tests, with performance optimization for mobile.

red-hog-studio.description: Developing gameplay systems, features and UI, with cinematics built in Sequencer. Producing technical documentation to support the team.

leonardo.description: Functional requirements analysis and coordination between development and client, with testing and documentation to support quality.

cluster-reply.description: Developing custom front-end/back-end logic (C# and JavaScript) on CRM platforms (Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Automate).
